plugins.name: plgn
plugins.description: Marketing content that ships. Draft a month of on-brand social posts from your terminal, then save, check, illustrate and schedule them into a real plgn workspace. Seven commands work with no account at all. Character limits and your brand's banned words are enforced server-side, so a post that breaks them cannot be published.
